value.rationale: The finite-width reset Gaussian has a natural information cost measurable at the endpoints and both periodic and exponential reset schedules are physically standard comparators. The exact theorem shows that neither clock uniformly dominates at a fixed mean: there is one and only one change of preference, giving a mathematically complete two-protocol phase diagram. This cannot be read from standard narrow-reset approximations or optimization of the protocols separately.
